name: Bookly
category: an AI reading companion for busy professionals

headline: Read less.
Remember more.
idea.promise: Bookly turns the books you mean to read into ten-minute conversations you actually finish. The brand should feel like a good library: calm, warm, a little bookish, and never in a hurry.
idea.personality: Warm, clear, quietly clever, never smug.

pillars.title: Calm over clever
pillars.body: Lots of space, soft paper tones and one deep green. Nothing blinks, nothing shouts.

pillars.title: Books first
pillars.body: Real covers, real quotes, real page numbers. The product is about reading, so the brand looks like reading.

pillars.title: One serif, one sans
pillars.body: Fraunces for headlines gives the bookish warmth. Inter does all the work everywhere else.

pillars.title: Plain words
pillars.body: We explain like a well-read friend, not a productivity guru.

dark.name: Forest
dark.use: Dark sections, the app's night mode, social posts.

accent.name: Bookly green
accent.use: The one action per view, links, highlights.

support.name: Bookmark
support.use: Small highlights only: a ribbon, a streak badge. Never text on linen.

headline: Like a friend
who reads a lot.
voice.summary: We sound like a well-read friend: warm, specific, a little playful, never preachy about productivity.
write: Finish the book you started in March.
Ten minutes a day. One chapter at a time.
We read the boring bits so you don't have to.
not: Unlock 10x knowledge with AI-powered reading hacks 🚀
The ultimate productivity tool for high performers.
voice.names: Bookly in text, bookly (lowercase) in the logo, Bookly Inc. for legal.

headline: Real books,
real light.
imagery.summary: Real books, real hands, real reading corners. Warm daylight, linen and wood. Never stock 'success' photos or glowing brains.
do: Books on tables, in hands, on trains.
Close crops of pages and margins.
dont: Stacks of money, trophies, mountain summits.
imagery.photoPrompt: documentary photo, warm window light, a person reading a paperback in a quiet corner, linen and wood tones, muted colour, shallow depth of field, no text, no logos
